The ECB euro reference rate for US dollar on 5 November 2026 was **1.1224** USD per euro, according to two sources:

- The [ECB USD rate page](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy%5Fand%5Fexchange%5Frates/euro%5Freference%5Fexchange%5Frates/html/eurofxref-graph-usd.en.html) lists 1.1224 for that date.
- The [Banca d'Italia's 5 Nov 2026 reference rates](https://www.bancaditalia.it/compiti/operazioni-cambi/cambio/cambi_rif_20261105) show "Dollaro USA 1,1224", which republishes the ECB rate.

Caveat: my search did not show the value on the ECB page, and the ECB's own PDF for that day didn't load the rate. The figure comes from the summarised page fetch and the Banca d'Italia listing, so check the ECB's daily XML feed if you need an official confirmation.

Sources:
- https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy%5Fand%5Fexchange%5Frates/euro%5Freference%5Fexchange%5Frates/html/eurofxref-graph-usd.en.html

A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck off the coast of eastern Japan on 6 November 2026 (UTC), about 156 km southeast of Hasaki, according to a USGS-sourced alert. Other reports place it about 169 km southeast of Asahi, east of Tokyo. The time was about 10:39 UTC (7:39 pm local). No tsunami warning or immediate damage was reported.

I couldn't confirm this on the USGS site. The page I found is a third-party aggregator and returned HTTP 403 when I tried to open it, so the reference town and distance come from search summaries and may be slightly off. The USGS event page is the authoritative source.

I also found a separate M6.1 in the Fiji region at 17:21 UTC on 5 November, at a depth of about 541 km. It is dated 5 November UTC, so it is probably not the event you mean.

Sources:
- [M 6.1 - 156 km SE of Hasaki, Japan (defconlevel.com)](https://www.defconlevel.com/alert/2026-11-06-usgs-earthquakes-m-6-1-156-km-se-of-hasaki-japan)

2026 年 10 月 20 日公布的 LPR 为：

- **1 年期：3.0%**
- **5 年期以上：3.5%**

两者均与上期持平。上一次下调是 2025 年 5 月，当时两个期限各下调 10 个基点。由于 7 天期逆回购利率已连续 17 个月未变，LPR 的定价基础本月也未改变。

我通过两篇媒体报道核实了数值：[华尔街见闻](https://wallstreetcn.com/articles/3783979) 和 [TrendForce](https://datatrack.trendforce.com/blog/content/66047/chinas-1-year-lpr-remains-unchanged-at-30-for-17-consecutive-months-as-the-central-bank-brews-pricing-benchmark-transition)。我没有直接查看中国货币网的官方公告原文，如需权威出处，请以该网站为准。

Sources:
- https://wallstreetcn.com/articles/3783979
- https://datatrack.trendforce.com/blog/content/66047/chinas-1-year-lpr-remains-unchanged-at-30-for-17-consecutive-months-as-the-central-bank-brews-pricing-benchmark-transition
